info.name: Techies E-Commerce API
info.description:
Backend for the Techies Android app.

**Start here:** run *Auth → Login*. Its test script stores `accessToken` as a collection variable, and every authenticated request uses it automatically — no copy-pasting.

Requests are ordered so the whole collection runs top to bottom in the Postman Runner: listing products stores a `productId`, creating an address stores an `addressId`, and so on.

**Checkout returns HTTP 200 even when the order fails** — branch on `order.status`, not the status code. See docs/API.md.

Saved examples are real captured responses, regenerated by `python3 scripts/generate-postman.py`.

request.description:
Email is unique, case-insensitive. Password needs 8+ chars with a letter and a digit.

**Returns 409 on any run after the first** — the account already exists. That is correct behaviour, and it exercises the duplicate-email path. Change the `email` variable to register a fresh account.

request.description: A new user gets an empty cart, never a 404. name/unitPrice/available may be absent if a downstream service is briefly unreachable.
Re-adding a product increments its line. Max 50 lines, 99 per line. Stock is NOT checked here.
quantity 0 removes the line.
Returns 200 with order.status = CONFIRMED. Stock is deducted and the cart cleared.

request.description: Returns 204. Kept out of the cart folder so a top-to-bottom run still has a cart to check out with. The pre-request script re-primes the cart, since checkout empties it.

Returns 204, and deleting the default promotes the next most recent.

Runs last because checkout needs this address to exist.
